samples.summary: Baseline-recording integrity gate is now bypassable for every font outside the hardcoded floor
samples.evidence: `waitForFontsReady` only records a failure (`webFontFailures`) when a REQUIRED_WEB_FONTS family is missing (line 546/556). Families outside the floor — the lazily injected per-family Google Fonts links from `ensureFontLink` (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-catalog.ts:151, used by themed-font-picker/more-fonts-dialog, which the `slides-pickers` / `slides-theme-panel` targets render) and `FONT_CATALOG`'s eager set — are now only soft-waited for 3s and merely `console.warn`ed (line 534-541). The `updateBaseline` refusal at line 707 keys off `webFontFailures`, so `UPDATE_VISUAL_BROWSER_BASELINE=true` can now commit baselines painted with fallback glyphs for exactly those picker families, and the gate reads as covered because it prints 'Refusing to record baselines from fallback glyphs' only for the floor. This is an integrity-of-verification weakness rather than an exploitable vulnerability, and it likely belongs to the correctness lens; flagged here only because it is a guard that was narrowed in this delta.

samples.summary: Origin filter in refetchPass checked for bypass — verified sound, noted for the record
samples.evidence: `link.href.startsWith("https://fonts.googleapis.com/")` operates on the DOM-resolved absolute URL, so `https://fonts.googleapis.com.evil.tld/` and `https://fonts.googleapis.com@evil.tld/` both fail the prefix (next char is `.`/`@`, not `/`). The pass also no longer constructs a URL (the `wbVisualRetry` param mutation was removed) — it only re-inserts existing elements — so there is no attacker-controllable URL construction left in this path. No action needed; recorded so the verifier knows this vector was traced and cleared.
